Hi Olivia,

Thanks for scheduling time with us today — sorry we missed you on the call. Quick note to keep momentum: we had planned a 30m discovery to cover your priority use-cases (low-latency inference for customer-facing search + embeddings for semantic ranking), expected traffic patterns (bursty evenings, ~3M tokens/day), and the security/compliance items (VPC + audit logs).

If it helps, below is a one-paragraph recap so your team can decide whether a short technical deep-dive is the right next step:
- Goal: validate integration approach (API vs Dedicated) and confirm estimated per-token cost at target latency.
- Outcome requested: technical runbook for a pilot (SLA targets, model variant, infra estimate).

We can rebook a tighter session (15–20m) that focuses just on architecture and the pilot checklist — Marissa (our solutions engineer) would join. Karthik is looped for approvals if we need to propose a reserved capacity path.

Please pick one of these slots and reply with a one-word confirmation ("Confirm") so we can hold it for 48 hours:
- Tue 15 May 2028, 10:00–10:20 AM PT
- Wed 16 May 2028, 08:00–08:20 AM PT

If neither works, here is a one-click calendar link: https://calendly.com/redwood/mateo-15m?month=2028-05

Attachments: redwood-inference-quickdeck.pdf (pdf, 12 pages) — short overview; mutual-action-plan-template.xlsx (xlsx) — draft pilot checklist.

If we don't hear back by EOD Friday we'll release the holds, but happy to keep this flexible.

Thanks —
